{{Quote|This sector has frequent meteor activity!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies" />}}
The '''Sarka sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that had frequent meteor activity<ref name="Deadly Allies" /> and bordered the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh]], [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche]], [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene]], and [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" />
